methodology: Averaged over the 231 manually-verified exploit transactions in the benchmark

stage1_latency.description: Stage 1 (deterministic signal extraction + TIG construction), no LLM calls

stage23_cloud_only_latency.description: Full Stage 2+3 with Tier 3 cloud inference (all queries routed to cloud)

stage23_hybrid_latency.description: Stage 2+3 with hybrid routing (Tier 1/2 local, Tier 3 cloud)

benign_prefilter.description: BENIGN pre-filter (Rule Classifier) routes non-exploit transactions directly to rejection, skipping Stage 2

notes: Hybrid routing reduces inference cost by ~58% relative to cloud-only routing.
The BENIGN pre-filter avoids ~40% of Stage 2 LLM calls on production traffic.
Stage 1 is fully deterministic with zero LLM calls.
